title: 947. N-Repeated Element in Size 2N Array

examples.explanation: The value 3 fills half the slots while every other value appears once.
Here 2 is the element occupying exactly half the array.
Four of the eight entries are 5, so 5 is the repeated element.

hints: Only one value appears more than once, so frequency counting finds it.
A value repeating N times must also sit close to one of its copies; comparing nearby entries works too.
